recentDiary.text: Went to sleep again. Not tired. Feel more bored this time. Still curious.
Went into the Music Shop. The bell jingled. Played my piano. The notes were wrong and clumsy. Kept trying anyway. Curious.
Rested. Not tired. Feel fine. A bit bored, maybe. Curious still.
Explored again. Found nothing new. Crickets outside. Feel fine. Still curious.
